photos.title: Oceanfront towers in south Myrtle Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: Four oceanfront towers with balconies on every floor, pools and lawns behind the dune, and the beach with umbrellas in front, in south Myrtle Beach, seen from a plane over the ocean. Behind the towers are a road, woods, and streets of two- and three-story houses.
photos.caption: Oceanfront towers in Myrtle Beach, with streets of houses behind them, seen from over the ocean in 2011.
photos.alt: Four oceanfront towers with balconies and pools behind the dune in Myrtle Beach, with streets of houses and woods behind them, seen from a plane over the ocean

photos.title: Garden City Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: Garden City Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: the beach, rows of beach houses, and the marsh and tidal creeks behind them, with docks on the far shore.
photos.caption: Beach houses between the ocean and the marsh at Garden City Beach, 2011.
photos.alt: Beach houses in rows between the ocean beach and a wide marsh with tidal creeks and boat docks at Garden City Beach, seen from a plane over the ocean

photos.title: Springmaid Pier, Myrtle Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: A long wooden fishing pier running from the beach into the ocean at Myrtle Beach, with a low building at its foot, a curved oceanfront hotel building and pools behind the dune, and a golf course and pond behind them, seen from a plane over the ocean.
photos.caption: Springmaid Pier in Myrtle Beach, seen from over the ocean in 2011. NOAA's water temperatures in the chart come from its gauge at this pier.
photos.alt: A long wooden fishing pier running from the beach out over the ocean at Myrtle Beach, with oceanfront buildings and pools behind the dune, seen from a plane over the ocean
